events.verdict: Poole (NOP) wraps McBride (NYK) and initiates contact that affects his ability to get to the pass.
Anunoby (NYK) brings his off-arm toward Williamson's (NOP) side and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Towns (NYK) and Queen (NOP) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Poole (NOP) brings his hand towards the ball and the contact with Brunson's (NYK) upper body is marginal.
Poole (NOP) extends his leg out and makes intentional foot to ball contact.
Williamson (NOP) and Towns (NYK) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.

Replay review of the foul called on Anunoby (NYK) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Anunoby extends his left arm forward and initiates contact with Williamson's (NOP) arm prior to his right hand making any contact with the ball.
Towns (NYK) establishes himself in Murphy III's (NOP) path prior to the contact.
Looney (GSW) legally contests Brunson's (NYK) shot attempt.
Looney (NOP) establishes himself in Anunoby's (NYK) path prior to the contact.
Bey (NOP) commits a take foul on McBride (NYK).
Williamson (NOP) establishes himself in McBride's (NYK) path prior to the contact.

McBride (NYK) jumps in front of Poole (NOP) and legally contests the shot attempt. McBride would miss Poole completely if not for Poole's last minute step forward prior to his upward shooting motion, which some body to body contact occurs. The contact is marginal and does not affect McBride's ability to contest nor does it affect Poole's shot attempt.
Bey (NOP) commits a take foul on McBride (NYK).
